# Helena's Specialty Pierogies

> Family-owned Ukrainian and Polish food shop in Kerhonkson, New York (Ulster County, Hudson Valley). Handmade pierogies since 1995, plus Polish kielbasa and specialty meats. Orders by phone or in person.

- Address: 5754 Route 209, Kerhonkson, NY 12446 (on Route 209 between Ellenville and Stone Ridge)
- Phone: (845) 626-2958
- Hours: Thursday–Sunday, 12–5 PM; closed Monday–Wednesday. In bad weather, call or check Facebook.
- Also known as: Helena's Specialty Foods
- Cuisine: Ukrainian, Polish, Eastern European
- Sold: pierogies by the dozen (about $12.75–$17), Polish meats by the pound (about $11–$12.50)
- Ordering: by phone or in person only; no online, email or Facebook orders; no shipping
- Payment: cash and local checks
- Lead time: one week for large orders, 2–3 weeks for holiday orders
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/helenaspierogies/

## Pages

- [Menu with prices](https://www.helenaspecialtyfoods.com/menu/): 20 pierogi flavors, seasonal fruit pierogies, kielbasa, Krakowska and kobanosy
- [Hours and directions](https://www.helenaspecialtyfoods.com/visit/)
- [Our story](https://www.helenaspecialtyfoods.com/story/): a Ukrainian and Polish family recipe, made by hand since 1995
- [FAQ](https://www.helenaspecialtyfoods.com/faq/): ordering, payment, shipping and hours
- [In the news](https://www.helenaspecialtyfoods.com/press/): Condé Nast Traveler, Hudson Valley Magazine, Hudson Valley One, WPDH, Hudson Valley Eats, Shawangunk Journal
